ns2:section.sectionText: 0 credit hour section. Course for students completing an internship within economics fields during the summer. Restricted for economics students. Students must have confirmed an internship in order to take the course. Course may be used for CPT. Online assignements, but there may be an arranged meeting before and/or after the semester with the instructor. Please see our website with information on enrolling: http://www.economics.illinois.edu/undergrad/career/internship/
